delta_assessment: Read Astra2 revision5 counterexample: a Bind planning-time routine can change lexical settings before Execute. The former Q/E-only barrier was insufficient under the stated routine trust boundary; this supersedes my revision5 assessment of that boundary.

Revision6 marks Q/P/B/D/E/C/S before forwarding, covering analysis/type-input, planning/revalidation, execution, resource release and transaction completion without assuming pre-Execute steps are effect-free.
New Q/P remains denied until matching validated Ready. B/E/C/D/S/H and COPY/cancellation progress remain available; consecutive Parse without Sync may be conservatively rejected.

Q and Sync seal ordered cycles; older Ready retains newer effects. COPY data/end stays under initiating Q/E so completion cannot strand an orphan cycle. Unsolicited later Ready is rejected rather than manufacturing acknowledgement.
Native PREPARE/EXECUTE accepted provenance and exact-source requirements remain intact.
implementation_acceptance_notes: Mark each specified effect pending before forwarding it. Capture Q/Sync barrier at current cycle before advancing; never clear newer effects when processing an older Ready.

Test P then P before Sync; B or D then new SQL; Close and Sync effects; ordinary P/B/D/E/S; older Ready after newer message; COPY completion without orphan pending state; malformed/unsolicited Ready and error-skip behavior.

Validate unsafe ParameterStatus before releasing any barrier or forwarding further new SQL. Test indirect UPDATE pg_settings and the pre-Execute planning scenario using synthetic peers or an isolated reviewed fixture.
Keep the agreed conservative63byte protocol prepared-name bound and cross-protocol alias tests; preserve full ACL pg_dump/pg_restore coverage and prior native/classifier/cache/state tests.
Conservative compatibility failures must close the connection and be reported honestly. Do not weaken admission, remove ACLs or silently bypass the proxy to make tooling pass.

formal_review.required_gate: After six final council seats, two clean builds must bind this exact specification and current Lean source before production edits.

formal_limits: Generic forwardEffect proves pending-source exclusion for whichever messages the adapter marks; it does not establish that the selected message classes exhaust PostgreSQL effect paths. Runtime classification and pinned-source review remain explicit obligations.
Cycle numbering, ordered Ready association, ParameterStatus timing, native body extraction/classification/name handling and Python implementation correspondence remain outside Lean proof scope.
No backend execution, SQL effect analysis, isolation or commercial-rights assurance is implied.
approval_scope: Exact revision6 design only; proof-first closure and runtime acceptance remain separate gates.
